note: NPGameDev Godot MCP toolkit (editor addon addons/godot_mcp_toolkit plus the npm bridge @npgamedev/godot-mcp-server) -- the server behind the watoom-godot MCP route. The four source files are byte-for-byte copies downloaded on 2026-11-13 from the main branch of the upstream repositories (raw.githubusercontent.com); no release commit was recorded, so the snapshot date is the only revision. Per-tool cards come from the generated tool reference; the access label (read-only / destructive / idempotent) is the upstream label, and a tool with no label is NOT promised to be read-only. Which of these tools the WatooM route actually allows is a separate, internal fact: see the watoom-godot-route product.
